parameters.query:
with p as (select $1::uuid as client_id, $2::jsonb as j),
raw as (
  select p.client_id,
         nullif(r->>'email','')                as email,
         nullif(r->>'first_name','')           as first_name,
         nullif(r->>'last_name','')            as last_name,
         nullif(r->>'job_title','')            as job_title,
         nullif(r->>'company_name','')         as company_name,
         nullif(r->>'website','')              as website,
         nullif(r->>'industry','')             as industry,
         nullif(r->>'headcount','')            as headcount_range,
         nullif(r->>'phone','')                as phone_number,
         nullif(r->>'phone_source','')         as phone_source,
         nullif(r->>'linkedin','')             as linkedin_url,
         nullif(r->>'country','')              as country,
         nullif(r->>'message_title','')        as message_title,
         (nullif(r->>'qualification',''))::public.lead_qualification as qualification,
         coalesce((r->>'meeting_booked')::boolean, false) as meeting_booked,
         coalesce((r->>'meeting_held')::boolean, false)   as meeting_held,
         coalesce((r->>'offer_sent')::boolean, false)     as offer_sent,
         coalesce((r->>'won')::boolean, false)            as won,
         nullif(r->>'reply_text','')           as reply_text,
         nullif(r->>'client_note','')          as client_note,
         nullif(r->>'campaign_external_id','') as campaign_external_id,
         (nullif(r->>'lead_received',''))::date as lead_received,
         (r->>'sequencer_id')::uuid            as sequencer_id
  from p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j) r
),
src as (
  select distinct on (lower(coalesce(email,'')), coalesce(first_name,''), coalesce(company_name,''))
         *
  from raw
  order by lower(coalesce(email,'')), coalesce(first_name,''), coalesce(company_name,''), lead_received nulls last
),
missing as (
  select s.*, c.id as campaign_id
  from src s
  left join public.campaigns c
         on c.client_id = s.client_id and c.external_id = s.campaign_external_id
  where not exists (
    select 1 from public.leads l
    where l.client_id = s.client_id
      and ( (s.email is not null and lower(l.email) = lower(s.email))
         or (s.email is null
             and l.company_name is not distinct from s.company_name
             and l.first_name  is not distinct from s.first_name) )
  )
)
, ins as (
insert into public.leads (
  id, client_id, campaign_id, email, first_name, last_name, job_title, company_name, website,
  industry, headcount_range, phone_number, phone_source, linkedin_url, country, message_title,
  qualification, meeting_booked, meeting_held, offer_sent, won, reply_text, client_note,
  coldunicorn_note, source, sequencer_id, created_at, updated_at)
select gen_random_uuid(), m.client_id, m.campaign_id, m.email, m.first_name, m.last_name,
       m.job_title, m.company_name, m.website, m.industry, m.headcount_range, m.phone_number,
       m.phone_source, m.linkedin_url, m.country, m.message_title, m.qualification,
       m.meeting_booked, m.meeting_held, m.offer_sent, m.won, m.reply_text, m.client_note,
       case when m.lead_received is null
            then 'Imported from the client Leads sheet 2026-07-22; the sheet row had no LEAD RECEIVED date, so created_at is the import time, not the real one.'
       end,
       'cold_email', m.sequencer_id,
       coalesce(m.lead_received::timestamptz, now()), now()
from missing m
returning id, sequencer_id, created_at
)
select (select client_id from p)                                        as client_id,
       (select count(*) from raw)                                       as sheet_rows,
       (select count(*) from src)                                       as after_dedupe,
       (select count(*) from ins)                                       as inserted,
       (select count(*) from ins where sequencer_id = '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000003') as aimfox;

select c.id::text as client_id, c.name
from public.clients c
join public.client_sequencers cs on cs.client_id = c.id
join public.sequencers s on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'emailbison'
where cs.external_workspace_id = $1
limit 1;
